logger.doc:name: LOG INFO START mf-impl-post-webhook
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'START - mf-impl-post-webhook']

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Compute Expected HMAC Signature
ee:transform.doc:description: Compute sha256=HEX(HMAC-SHA256(webhookSecret, rawBody)) for comparison with x-hub-signature-256

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import dw::Crypto output text/plain --- "sha256=" ++ Crypto::HMACWith(p('secure::github.webhookSecret') as Binary, vars.rawBody, "HmacSHA256")

choice.doc:name: CHOICE signature valid?
choice.doc:description: Reject any delivery whose x-hub-signature-256 header does not match the computed HMAC

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Invalid Webhook Signature
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INVALID webhook signature | delivery=' ++ vars.ghDelivery ++ ' | event=' ++ vars.ghEvent]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "invalid signature", correlationId: correlationId }

choice.doc:name: CHOICE duplicate delivery?
choice.doc:description: Skip processing if this delivery UUID was already handled

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Duplicate Delivery Skipped
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'duplicate delivery, skipping | delivery=' ++ vars.ghDelivery]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, duplicate: true, correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Webhook Received
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'webhook received | event=' ++ vars.ghEvent ++ ' | action=' ++ (payload.action default 'unknown') ++ ' | delivery=' ++ vars.ghDelivery]

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO PR Merged
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'PR merged | branch=' ++ vars.mergedBranch ++ ' | prUrl=' ++ vars.prUrl]

choice.doc:name: Is Branch Mapped to a Job?

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Update Job Status to DEPLOYING

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- payload mergeWith { status: "DEPLOYING", prUrl: vars.prUrl, branchName: vars.mergedBranch, updatedAt: nowUtc() }

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Job DEPLOYING
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'job DEPLOYING | awaiting CD pipeline callback']

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Branch Not Tracked
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'branch not tracked, ignoring | branch=' ++ vars.mergedBranch]

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Non-Merge Event Ignored
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'webhook event ignored | event=' ++ vars.ghEvent ++ ' | action=' ++ (payload.action default 'unknown')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO END mf-impl-post-webhook
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - mf-impl-post-webhook']

flow.name: mf-impl-post-cd-result
flow.doc:description: Receive CD pipeline result callback; authenticate, finalize job status, release lock.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO START mf-impl-post-cd-result
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'START - mf-impl-post-cd-result']

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Compute Expected CD HMAC Signature
ee:transform.doc:description: Compute sha256=HEX(HMAC-SHA256(webhookSecret, rawBody)) for comparison with X-CD-Signature-256

choice.doc:name: CHOICE cd-result auth valid?
choice.doc:description: Reject unless a valid HMAC signature (X-CD-Signature-256) OR the transitional shared token (X-CD-Token) is presented

when.expression: #[not ( (vars.cdSignature != '' and vars.cdSignature == vars.expectedCdSig) or (vars.cdToken != '' and vars.cdToken == p('secure::github.webhookSecret')) )]
when.doc:name: auth missing or invalid

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Invalid CD Auth
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'invalid CD auth (X-CD-Signature-256/X-CD-Token) â€” rejecting']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "invalid cd token", correlationId: correlationId }

choice.doc:name: CHOICE cd stage?
choice.doc:description: Route MUnit (test) callbacks to the park/resume handler; deploy callbacks to finalize

choice.doc:name: CHOICE munit result?
choice.doc:description: MUnit failure → park MUNIT_FAILED; success → resume if parked

choice.doc:name: CHOICE parkable?
choice.doc:description: Ignore when already parked or already in a terminal state

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO MUnit failure idempotent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'munit failure ignored (already ' ++ (vars.curStatus default '?') ++ ')']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, idempotent: true, jobId: vars.jobId, status: vars.curStatus }

%dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- vars.jobRec mergeWith { status: "MUNIT_FAILED", error: (vars.cdError default "MUnit tests failed in CI"), updatedAt: nowUtc() }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { channel: p('slack.channel'), text: (":x: *MUnit tests FAILED* — " ++ vars.appName ++ "
Job " ++ vars.jobId ++ " is paused (MUNIT_FAILED)." ++ "
Fix the tests; the upgrade resumes automatically when CI reports a test success." ++ (if (vars.jiraTicketId != null) ("
Jira: <" ++ (p('jira.baseUrl') default '') ++ "/browse/" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String) ++ "|" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String) ++ ">") else "") ++ (if (vars.prUrl != null) ("
" ++ (vars.prUrl as String)) else "")) }

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Slack MUnit-failed failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Slack MUNIT_FAILED notification error swallowed: ' ++ (error.description default 'unknown')]

set-variable.value: #[output text/plain --- ('MUnit tests FAILED in CI for ' ++ (vars.appName as String) ++ ' (job ' ++ (vars.jobId as String) ++ '). The upgrade is paused (MUNIT_FAILED); fix the tests and CI will resume it on the next successful test run. ' ++ ((vars.cdError default '') as String))]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET jiraCommentText (munit failed)

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Job MUNIT_FAILED
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'job MUNIT_FAILED | awaiting MUnit fix']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, jobId: vars.jobId, status: "MUNIT_FAILED" }

choice.doc:name: CHOICE was parked?
choice.doc:description: Resume only when the job is currently parked in MUNIT_FAILED

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- vars.jobRec mergeWith { status: "PR_OPEN", error: null, updatedAt: nowUtc() }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { channel: p('slack.channel'), text: (":white_check_mark: *MUnit tests passing again* — " ++ vars.appName ++ "\nJob " ++ vars.jobId ++ " resumed (PR_OPEN); ready to merge/deploy." ++ (if (vars.prUrl != null) ("\n" ++ (vars.prUrl as String)) else "")) }

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Slack MUnit-resumed failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Slack MUnit-resumed notification error swallowed: ' ++ (error.description default 'unknown')]

set-variable.value: #[output text/plain --- ('MUnit tests are passing again for ' ++ (vars.appName as String) ++ ' (job ' ++ (vars.jobId as String) ++ '). The upgrade has resumed (PR_OPEN) and is ready to merge/deploy.')]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET jiraCommentText (resumed)

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Job resumed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'job resumed | MUNIT_FAILED→PR_OPEN (MUnit green)']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, resumed: true, jobId: vars.jobId, status: "PR_OPEN" }

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO MUnit success noted
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'munit success noted (job not parked, status=' ++ (vars.curStatus default '?') ++ ')']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, jobId: vars.jobId, status: vars.curStatus, note: "munit success noted" }

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Unknown MUnit result
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'unknown stage=test result=' ++ vars.cdResult]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "invalid result (expected success|failure)", correlationId: correlationId }

choice.doc:name: CHOICE already terminal?
choice.doc:description: Skip if the job was already finalized by a previous cd-result callback

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO CD Result Already Final
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'cd-result already final, skipping | status=' ++ vars.curStatus]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, idempotent: true, jobId: vars.jobId, status: vars.curStatus }

otherwise.doc:name: job not yet terminal â€” proceed

choice.doc:name: CHOICE cdResult success|failure|unknown?
choice.doc:description: Finalize job as DEPLOYED (success) or FAILED_DEPLOY (failure)

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: output application/java --- (vars.coords.orgId default p('anypoint.defaultOrgId')) as String
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { verified: false, found: false, status: 'DISABLED', healthy: false, runtimeVersion: null }

set-variable.value: #[if ((vars.verify.verified default false) and not (vars.verify.healthy default false)) 'FAILED_DEPLOY' else 'DEPLOYED']
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET vars.deployVerdict

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- vars.jobRec mergeWith { status: vars.deployVerdict, deployUrl: vars.deployUrl, platformVerified: (vars.verify.verified default false), platformStatus: (vars.verify.status default null), platformRuntimeVersion: (vars.verify.runtimeVersion default null), completedAt: nowUtc(), updatedAt: nowUtc() } mergeWith (if (vars.deployVerdict == "FAILED_DEPLOY") { error: "CD reported success but platform status=" ++ (vars.verify.status default "UNKNOWN") } else {})

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { channel: p('slack.channel'), text: (":white_check_mark: *Java 17 upgrade DEPLOYED* â€” " ++ vars.appName ++ "
Job " ++ vars.jobId ++ (if ((vars.verify.verified default false)) ("
Platform status: " ++ (vars.verify.status default "UNKNOWN")) else "
Platform: unverified (trusting CI)") ++ (if (vars.jiraTicketId != null) ("
Jira: <" ++ (p('jira.baseUrl') default '') ++ "/browse/" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String) ++ "|" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String) ++ ">") else "") ++ (if (vars.deployUrl != null) ("
" ++ vars.deployUrl) else "")) }

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Slack DEPLOYED notification failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Slack DEPLOYED notification error swallowed: ' ++ (error.description default 'unknown')]

set-variable.value: #[output text/plain --- if (vars.deployVerdict == 'DEPLOYED') ('Java 17 upgrade DEPLOYED for ' ++ (vars.appName as String) ++ ' (job ' ++ (vars.jobId as String) ++ '). Platform status: ' ++ ((vars.verify.status default 'n/a') as String) ++ '.') else ('Java 17 upgrade marked FAILED_DEPLOY for ' ++ (vars.appName as String) ++ ' (job ' ++ (vars.jobId as String) ++ '). CI reported success but platform status=' ++ ((vars.verify.status default 'UNKNOWN') as String) ++ '.')]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET vars.jiraCommentText (finalize)

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Job finalized
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'job finalized | status=' ++ vars.deployVerdict ++ ' | platformVerified=' ++ (vars.verify.verified default false) ++ ' | platformStatus=' ++ (vars.verify.status default 'n/a') ++ ' | deployUrl=' ++ (vars.deployUrl default 'n/a')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, jobId: vars.jobId, status: vars.deployVerdict, platformVerified: (vars.verify.verified default false) }

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Update Job Status to FAILED_DEPLOY

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- vars.jobRec mergeWith { status: "FAILED_DEPLOY", error: (vars.cdError default "CD pipeline reported failure"), rolledBack: true, completedAt: nowUtc(), updatedAt: nowUtc() }

set-variable.value: #[output text/plain --- ('Java 17 upgrade FAILED_DEPLOY for ' ++ (vars.appName as String) ++ ' (job ' ++ (vars.jobId as String) ++ '). ' ++ ((vars.cdError default 'CD pipeline reported failure') as String) ++ (if ((vars.revertPrUrl default '') != '') ' A rollback (revert) PR has been opened to restore the pre-upgrade state.' else ' Rollback attempted.'))]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET vars.jiraCommentText (failure)

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Job FAILED_DEPLOY
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'job FAILED_DEPLOY']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { acknowledged: true, jobId: vars.jobId, status: "FAILED_DEPLOY" }

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN Unknown CD Result
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'unknown cdResult=' ++ vars.cdResult]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "invalid result (expected success|failure)", correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO END mf-impl-post-cd-result
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - mf-impl-post-cd-result']
